says: Today's tooling records: 0123's heartbeat goes red when a merge has waited more than two hours for a passing mutation run, but 0535 moved the mutation run to every 3 hours, and the two hours were derived from an hourly run.
proof: .decisions/0123-githubs-schedule-starts-the-mutation-run.md:73 reads 'goes red when a merge on main has waited more than two hours for a passing run'; .decisions/0535-pull-requests-stay-fast-the-schedule-carries-the-rest.md:47 says mutation starts 'from the schedule every 3 hours'; .agents/skills/mutation/scripts/heartbeat.ts:14 derives the two hours from a merge that 'waits up to one hour for the next' run. No record changes the heartbeat's limit.
cost: Once mutation runs on 0535's schedule, a merge just after a run waits up to 3 hours for the next, so the heartbeat reads late between most runs and stops meaning anything.
